Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 6  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Icehouse pieces were first released in 1989 based on a misinterpretation of the BoardGameGeek page. While the page mentions a December 1989 test run of 100 sets, it does not confirm this as the official commercial release date of Icehouse pieces. The Planner failed to distinguish between a test run and the actual release year, leading to a premature declaration that Icehouse pieces were released first without fully verifying authoritative sources for both games.
